resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source DFT package; any recent version (>=6.0) works.

resources.notes: The agent must install Quantum ESPRESSO and all required dependencies.

resources.name: SSSP Pseudopotential Library (PW91)

access.notes: Must select PW91-compatible pseudopotentials (e.g., C.pw91-n-van_ak.UPF, N.pw91-n-van_ak.UPF, O.pw91-n-van_ak.UPF).

resources.notes: Alternative public PW91 pseudopotential libraries are acceptable.
